summary: Devon Energy filed an 8-K announcing that its wholly-owned subsidiary Devon Energy Production Company, L.P. agreed to sell Eagle Ford oil and gas assets in South Texas to Crescent (Eagle Ford) LLC, a Crescent Energy Company subsidiary, for $4.2 billion in cash, subject to customary purchase price adjustments tied to a July 1, 2026 effective date. The transaction is expected to close in Q4 2026 or early 2027, contingent on HSR waiting-period clearance and other customary conditions. No board recommendation or advisor was disclosed. The all-cash structure removes Devon's Eagle Ford position, leaving Crescent with an expanded South Texas footprint; the HSR regulatory clock is the key gating item for deal timing.
